name: smartcompare-ai
description: SmartCompare AI - Mobile Phone Comparison Platform

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true })"
